qualification: Six declared ordinary-object/template counterexamples. Complete native/provider mismatches must fail and remain research; no qualification is transferred from the sixteen script controls.

cases.source:
<script>
const holder = { $listeners: 7 }
export default {
  methods: { read() { return holder.$listeners } }
}
</script>
<template><div /></template>

messages.message: [vize:script/no-deprecated-dollar-listeners-api] $listeners was removed in Vue 3 and merged into $attrs
messages.help: Replace $listeners with $attrs. In Vue 3 listeners are passed as on-prefixed props and are exposed through $attrs (or useAttrs() in the Composition API).

cases.source:
<script>
const holder = { $scopedSlots: 7 }
export default {
  methods: { read() { return holder.$scopedSlots } }
}
</script>
<template><div /></template>

messages.help: Replace $scopedSlots with $slots. In Vue 3 every slot is a function, so the separate scoped-slots property no longer exists.

messages.message: [vize:script/no-use-computed-property-like-method] 'total' is a computed property and must not be called like a method.
messages.help: A computed property exposes a value, not a function. Drop the call parentheses ({{ name }}), or move the logic into a method if you need to invoke it.

<script>
const holder = { props: { count: { type: Number, default: "seven" } } }
